QF.id: Cat III AIF Due Diligence and Risk_12

question.text: Fund Size / AUM is a relevant DD consideration because:

answer.text: Too-small AUM may indicate illiquidity risk; too-large AUM may signal strategy capacity constraints

explanation.text: The Logic: AUM has two-sided relevance: too-small = operational viability; too-large = capacity constraints. The Trap: Monotonic interpretations (bigger-is-better) miss the nuance. Cross-Exam Context: Strategy-capacity concept. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Ask the manager their stated capacity and compare AUM to that capacity.
